Based on your answers, fasting protocols are not offered. The support lines below are here if you\'d like to talk to someone, and you can still read how the body responds to fasting. You can change your answers in Settings.
Please confirm you have discussed fasting with your doctor before starting.
Alerts may arrive up to 15 minutes late. Allow exact alarms so your end-of-fast alert is on time.
If you take any medication, check with your doctor first.
Tell someone you are doing a long fast and who to call if you feel unwell.
Stop and seek care if you faint, have chest pain, palpitations, confusion or severe weakness.
You are planning a fast of more than 72 hours. Fasts this long carry more risk. Please confirm you understand this.
Fasting Shift is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat any condition.
Start with a small, easy meal such as broth, eggs or yoghurt. Eat slowly and wait before a larger meal.
After 3 days or more, keep the first day of eating gentle: small portions spread out, low in sugar, with electrolytes.
After a very long fast, refeeding needs care. Keep meals small for the first days, and contact a doctor if you feel weak, confused, short of breath or have swelling.
